title: D=0 regression + notched bar verification
objective: Phase 6 acceptance: at D = 0 everywhere, Lemaitre reproduces J2 power-law exactly; on a notched tension bar, damage localises at the notch root as expected from the literature.
scope: Extend the existing J2 power-law benchmark so it can run with `material='lemaitre'` at parameters that keep D = 0 throughout.
Assert displacement fields match between the two within 1e-8.
Build a notched tension bar mesh (a small rectangular bar with a semi-circular notch) and run damage evolution.
Assert D is highest in the element(s) adjacent to the notch root and drops off away from it.
implementation_steps: Add a parametrisation for `test_benchmarks.py` covering the Lemaitre-at-zero case.
Build the notched bar mesh (programmatic, no file I/O).
Run the simulation with the generated Lemaitre solver.
Extract per-element D and assert the spatial distribution (e.g. max(D) occurs within 1 element of the notch root).
acceptance_criteria: Lemaitre at D=0 matches J2 power-law within 1e-8 on the shared benchmark.
Notched bar: D localises at the notch root (max within 1 element of the geometric notch).
risks: Damage localisation depends on mesh size (classic CDM pathology). Mitigation: use a consistent mesh across test runs and document that results are mesh-dependent; B9 handles the nonlocal-regularisation follow-up.
completion_notes: Test 1 (D=0 regression): 2×1×1 Hex8 with mixed x-tension + z-shear (non-isotropic state, Phase 2 physics_error mitigation). Lemaitre suppressed via eps_D=1e9 AND S_d=1e9 belt-and-braces. max|u_lem − u_j2| = 3.75e-16 (7+ orders below 1e-8 spec).

Test 2 (notched bar): inline _build_notched_bar_mesh — 6×3×1 cosine-bell notched bar, 18 Hex8 elements, all positive Jacobians verified. Loading: 0.25% strain/step × 8 steps with max_iter=40 Newton (P6-2 Gate B forward-warning).

Notched bar result: argmax(D) = element 14 (identical to geometrically-nearest notch-root element). D_max ≈ 6.23e-2 at notch root vs 8.23e-3 at far end (7.5× drop-off). Localisation within 1.5·h Euclidean ball of notch-root asserted.

n_hard=1.0 (linear hardening) used in notched-bar test to avoid `n·α^(n-1)` power-law tangent singularity under sub-linear Newton from undamaged J2 tangent (Option A from P6-2). Documented as V&V follow-up: full power-law + active damage coverage deferred to P10-7 Taylor impact when damage-aware consistent tangent lands.
All damage parameters (S_d, s_d, eps_D, D_crit) passed explicitly in both tests — no reliance on emit_main silent fallbacks (P6-2 Gate B forward-warning).
P6T5 TODO-cleanup guard: 1 failed → 0 failed (scaffold residue cleared).
Fast suite: 1215 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed — Phase 6 exit baseline.
Follow-ups logged for P10 V&V (mesh-convergence + nonlocal regularisation for CDM localisation pathology) and P10-7 Taylor impact (companion acceptance with n_hard < 1 + active damage).
